basic_details.job_title: BHU Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 11 Computer Operator, System Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: System Engineer, Maintenance Engineer (Junior), Computer Operator Gr.-I and 3 more
basic_details.short_information: Banaras Hindu University (BHU), Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, has invited applications for 11 posts in 6 roles under Advt No. 03/2026-2027. The posts include System Engineer, Maintenance Engineer (Junior), Computer Operator Gr.-I, AC Operator and 2 more. Applications are accepted online until 25 November 2026.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 2,09,200, depending on the post

how_to_apply: Register on the Recruitment & Assessment Cell portal on the BHU website, then fill the online application at www.bhu.ac.in/rac.
Upload digital passport size photograph and signature in JPEG, each not exceeding 50 kb.
Pay the application fee through the payment gateway after submitting the form, if applicable.
Submit the form online by 25-11-2026, 5.00 p.m.
Send the downloaded hard copy with all enclosures to the Registrar, Recruitment & Assessment Cell, Holkar House, BHU, Varanasi-221005, on or before 30-11-2026.
important_instructions: The fee is non-refundable. Posts advertised earlier under Advt. No. 20/2023-2024 and 06/2018-2019 are cancelled. Earlier applicants may claim a fee refund by emailing [email protected] with post applied, transaction ID and bank account details. The number of posts is open to change, and the University may withdraw any post.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: M.Tech/M.E./M.S. (Computer Science/IT/Electronics & Communication) with 55% and 5 years relevant experience; B.Tech/B.E. (CS/IT/E&C) or MCA or M.Sc Computer Science (with B.Sc Computer Science) with 55% and 7 years experience; M.Sc (CS/IT) with B.Sc in any Science subject, 55% and 8 years experience. Experience required: Industry/University computer centre experience in server configuration, storage systems, backup systems, Linux/Unix, software engineering/design and validation, databases, computer network. Age limit: Maximum 50 years. Pay: Level 12, ₹78,800-2,09,200. Qualification required: B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering/Computer Science & Engineering with 55%. Experience required: 5 years at appropriate level in PSUs/private organisation/university in computer network administration and computer hardware, including massive UPS systems and centralized air-conditioning plants. Age limit: Maximum 40 years. Pay: Level 10, ₹56,100-1,77,500. Qualification required: B.Sc Computer Science with 55%; BCA with 55%; B.Sc with 55% and PGDCA. Age limit: Maximum 32 years. Pay: Level 5, ₹29,200-92,300. Qualification required: ITI (Refrigeration and Air Conditioning) from NCVT/SCVT accredited ITI. Experience required: 2 years in operation and maintenance of air-conditioning plants, including VRV system over 500 TR. Age limit: Maximum 32 years. Pay: Level 3, ₹21,700-69,100. Qualification required: Intermediate with science; Certificate course in computer hardware of minimum six months. Age limit: Maximum 32 years. Pay: Level 1, ₹18,000-56,900. Qualification required: High School; ITI in Electrician/Plumber/Fitter/Welder/Wireman trade from NCVT/SCVT accredited ITI. Experience required: 1 year in the concerned trade. Age limit: Maximum 32 years. Pay: Level 1, ₹18,000-56,900.

content_sections.heading: How Will BHU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written test Skill test Verification of original documents University will conduct a written test and a skill test. Syllabus for the written and skill tests will be notified later. Shortlisted candidates will be called for original document verification. University may form a screening committee and set shortlisting criteria depending on the number of applications. Daily wage/contractual employees of the University get 4% weightage per year of service, up to 20%, for Group C posts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BHU Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Register on the Recruitment & Assessment Cell portal on the BHU website, then fill the online application at www.bhu.ac.in/rac. Upload digital passport size photograph and signature in JPEG, each not exceeding 50 kb. Pay the application fee through the payment gateway after submitting the form, if applicable. Submit the form online by 25-11-2026, 5.00 p.m. Send the downloaded hard copy with all enclosures to the Registrar, Recruitment & Assessment Cell, Holkar House, BHU, Varanasi-221005, on or before 30-11-2026. For technical problems, email [email protected] .

The number of posts is open to change, and the University may withdraw any post.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BHU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in BHU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 vacancies: 1 System Engineer, 1 Maintenance Engineer (Junior), 3 Computer Operator Gr.-I, 3 AC Operator, 1 Laboratory Attendant, 2 Workshop Attendant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for BHU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UR/EWS/OBC - Group A Non-teaching: Rs. 1000. UR/EWS/OBC - Group B & C Non-teaching: Rs. 500. SC/ST/PwBD/Women: Nil.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - System Engineer: maximum 50 years; Maintenance Engineer (Junior): maximum 40 years; Computer Operator Gr.-I: maximum 32 years; AC Operator: maximum 32 years; Laboratory Attendant: maximum 32 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 12, ₹78,800-2,09,200 for System Engineer, Level 10, ₹56,100-1,77,500 for Maintenance Engineer (Junior), Level 5, ₹29,200-92,300 for Computer Operator Gr.-I, Level 3, ₹21,700-69,100 for AC Operator, Level 1, ₹18,000-56,900 for Laboratory Attendant.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Tech/B.E., M.E./M.Tech, B.Sc, M.Sc, MCA, MD/MS, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian citizens can apply. Serving employees must route the application through proper channel or submit a No Objection Certificate. Eligibility is decided as on the last date and time of online application submission.

faq.answer: Candidates submitting incomplete applications are rejected. Canvassing in any form leads to disqualification.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written test. Skill test. Verification of original documents. University will conduct a written test and a skill test.
